name: GitLab DevOps Platform Integration
description: Integration pack for GitLab, providing connectivity to GitLab Git repositories, Merge Request reviews, `.gitlab-ci.yml` pipeline triggers, Container Registry, and SAST/DAST security scanning.

capabilities.name: Code Review
capabilities.description: Integrates GitLab Merge Request code discussions, code owner approvals, and diff reviews.

capabilities.name: DevOps & CI/CD Engineering
capabilities.description: Integrates GitLab CI/CD runner pipelines, artifact caching, and multi-stage deployment jobs.

capabilities.name: Security Engineering
capabilities.description: Integrates GitLab SAST, Dependency Scanning, Secret Detection, and License Compliance.

checklists.name: GitLab Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for GitLab API token access, project webhooks, and GitLab CI runner tags.

items.statement: GitLab Personal / Project Access Token grants api scope for repository and pipeline access.
GitLab Webhook triggers on Merge Request events and Push events with secret token verification.
GitLab CI runner tags match deployment environment requirements (docker, shell, kubernetes).

reviewGates.name: GitLab Integration Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The DevOps Engineer confirms that GitLab API tokens and runner configurations satisfy connectivity requirements.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the GitLab integration verification confirm pipeline trigger capability and access scope?
